title: Fix student ID collisions UX + add empty-list diagnostics

requirements.summary: Stop generating student IDs on the client; rely on backend to generate globally unique IDs while keeping add-student UX unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a student in an empty class/section after adding students elsewhere still produces a unique ID that does not conflict with existing students.
No class/section uses duplicated IDs that cause another class/section’s student to disappear.
User-facing behavior remains the same: user enters Student Name, Roll Number, and Parent Mobile Number and the student appears in the current class/section list.

file_operations.description: Remove client-side ID generation logic from the add-student mutation and call the backend capability that generates a globally unique ID (use the typed backend interface methods). Update student fetching hook(s) to correctly adapt backend return shapes so list items retain stable IDs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Keep the existing form fields/validation and update submission wiring (if needed) so it no longer depends on any locally computed student ID, while preserving current user-facing behavior and existing authorization messaging via the authorization system. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the student list renders correctly with IDs returned from backend-generated IDs (stable React keys, edit/delete wiring) after the add-student flow change. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an empty-state recovery/diagnostic UI that clarifies why the student list is empty and optionally confirms whether any students exist in the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: When the Student List is empty, the UI distinguishes (in English) between: not logged in/not authorized, loading error, and genuinely no students.
There is a way to confirm whether any students exist in the backend even if the selected class/section list is empty (without exposing private data to unauthorized users).

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook that can load a safe diagnostic signal (e.g., total student count derived from getAllStudents) gated by authentication/authorization state so it is not invoked for guests/unauthorized users. Return only the minimal data needed for diagnostics in the UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Enhance the empty student list UI to show distinct English states for: not logged in/not authorized (prompt to log in), loading error (show actionable error), and genuinely empty. Add an optional 'Check if any students exist' diagnostic action that triggers the gated diagnostic hook and displays a clear result without exposing private student details to unauthorized users. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
